specs.Hardware Platform: Android 5.0 or later, Linux Kernel 2.6 or later, Windows 8/8.1/10/Mac OS X 10.6 or later

features: SE760 External SSD - The SE760 external SSD combines elegant aesthetics with high-speed performance. Using the USB 3.2 Gen 2 interface the SE760 delivers read speeds of up to 1000 MB/s
STORAGE - Are your games taking forever to load? With the SE760 1 TB large capacity, store your games and load them faster. Built with advanced 3D NAND Flash
USB Type-C - The SE760 features a USB-C (Type C) connector, which is reversible (backward compatible with USB USB 2.0). There's no annoying up or down like with traditional USB
PERFORMANCE - The SE760 sports read speed of up to 1,000 MB/s, which is up 12.5 times faster than an external hard drive. Supports Windows, Mac OS, Android, Xbox One, PS4 consoles
DESIGN - The SE760 SSD sports a clean, streamlined design characterized by a sturdy metal shell with an understated hairline-brushed surface
description: The SE760 external SSD combines elegant aesthetics with high-speed performance. What's more, the SSD sports a clean, streamlined design characterized by a sturdy metal shell with a clean hairline-brushed surface. A USB 3.2 Gen 2 interface delivers read/write speeds of up to 1050/1000 MB/s.
